CODE
Art. 2.3.37. 
Action for nullity 
An action for nullity must be brought, on pain of foreclosure, within one year of the day on which the claimant spouse became aware of the act performed by his or her spouse and at the latest before the final liquidation of the regime.
 If the spouse dies before the time limit is reached, his or her heirs have a further period of one year from the date of death.
